basis.governing_question: What strategy should Banco Horizonte adopt for its digital channels?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Assess the current state of Banco Horizonte's digital channels and identify the gaps the strategy must close.

gate.label: Focus areas sign-off
gate.decision: Which gaps in the digital channels does the strategy address first?

phases.name: Research
phases.objective_one_line: Analyze customer needs and competitor moves in digital retail banking to set the options for the strategy.

gate.label: Option selection
gate.decision: Which digital channel options does the steering group take into Design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define Banco Horizonte's digital channels strategy and the plan to put it into action.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Does the steering group approve the digital channels strategy as the final result?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not stated; 10-15 weeks is an estimate resting on one bank, two named stakeholders and no stated channel scope or timeline.
The brief names no stages, so the split into Diagnostic, Research and Design is an estimate of the stages needing separate decisions.
No method archetype fits a digital channels strategy, so archetype_id is null and the three phases are built from the brief.
